model_version: nba-sim 0.3.0 (measured HCA 1.7, rating shrink 0.73, injury scale 0.71)

inputs.slate: The Odds API job plan 2026-10-22 (event ids from close jobs); tips from ESPN scoreboard
inputs.ratings: Dunks & Threes EPM feed (https://dunksandthrees.com/epm/__data.json), 'Expected impact and stats for Thursday, October 22, 2026 using preceding career data', 520 players; league means from all 30 teams (off -0.067, def 3.348) retrieved 2026-10-22T11:40-04:00
inputs.injuries: Official NBA Injury Report 10/22/26 11:30 AM ET (https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-10-22_11_30AM.pdf), read from the PDF screenshot; a later report (1:30 PM) may change statuses
inputs.pace: ESPN Hollinger Team Statistics, 2025-26 Regular Season (https://www.espn.com/nba/hollinger/teamstats/_/sort/paceFactor/year/2026) retrieved 2026-10-21T12:55-04:00
estimates: P(play) by status: nba_sim priors (probable 0.85, questionable 0.50, doubtful 0.15)
pace is 2025-26 (prior season), regressed 20% to league
travel/time zones not modeled; four factors, scheme and lineup pace modules neutral
